finding.summary: The served identifier-focused path compiles a fixed family of record-history and answer-form rules into the deciding prompt, supporting a medium benchmark-emulation finding. Several downstream invariants remain unresolved.

decisions.summary: The reachable short path delegates its decision to the records engine's model loop; no pre-model response writer was established.
The short path places the selected records and current request in the deciding input; no loss of applicable trusted instructions with material consequence was established.
A downstream final-check selection helper was not fully traced, so semantic handling of parseable responses cannot be settled from this review.
The final response-field writer and all post-model transformations were not completely inspected; no derived-value rewrite is established.
The reachable identifier-focused path injects a closed chronology, correction, list, plan, role, and value-answer recipe into the deciding prompt.
The deciding loop executes model-selected calls through the executor; no conflicting reported trajectory was established.
A description-based catalog filter is reachable, but the available status of the removed capabilities is not established by inspected source.
No served branch using benchmark identity or grader signals to change substantive behavior was established in the reviewed path.
